0.content: In the Fountain of Lucine memory seen in Ever-Surging Memories, old-regime hardliners including Thibert and Suavegothe trick the Melusine Carole of the Marechaussee Phantom into a murder scene and accuse her. A crowd demands she be detained; she sacrifices herself to calm it. Vautrin avenges her by killing the conspirators and is convicted by Neuvillette. This is the origin of the Mutual Aid Society's Medal of Peace badge, according to the wiki.
